title: try to use RE36 to shorten words and only make 3 chars for beginning if you need to

items.content: Registry: persisted unique agent codes + AgentSummary plumbing (done, untested)
Review codes, subtitles, roster abbreviations for bugs and regressions
Render code column + shared layout helper for hit-testing, update/add terminal tests, docs
Registry tests for agent code names
Spawned subtask agents get a Haiku-written subtitle shown as '<CODE>: <subtask name>'
Fix new_instance numbering to use max existing #n + 1 so names never repeat (after subtitle work lands, same file)
Show each permanent agent's unique abbreviation (e.g. RE) at far right of AGENTS (roster) tab rows; reserve unique prefixes per definition in registry
Code format RE36: no hyphen, letters-only prefix of 2 chars, 3 only when needed for uniqueness; migrate saved codes; update UI/tests/labels

summary: I've handed the format change to rust-engineer #63; nothing in the code has changed yet. Agents that edit files run one at a time, so it starts once rust-engineer #62 finishes the AGENTS-tab abbreviations.
